cases.claim: The Northmere municipal ferry service opened to the public on May 8.

passages.A: The Northmere municipal ferry began public passenger service on May 8. Its April 26 trips were closed trials for staff.
passages.B: On May 8 we joined the first Northmere ferry crossing open to the public. The service had operated crew-only tests in April.

cases.claim: Residents needed a paid pass to enter Orchard Market on Sundays in June.

passages.A: June notices for Orchard Market: visitors on Sundays enter free. Paid passes are required on Saturdays only.
passages.B: The June Sunday ledgers record free public entry at Orchard Market. Payments in the ledger are for Saturday access.

cases.claim: The Cedar House charter was ratified by a unanimous vote.

passages.A: The notice lists ratification of the Cedar House charter on the agenda for Monday.
passages.B: The meeting adjourned at nine and the clerk filed the agenda. A separate document contains vote totals.
